progress.listen: Press a button on the light's remote, close to an ESPHome board. Listening for {seconds} seconds.

nothing_heard.title: Nothing heard
nothing_heard.description: No remote press was heard. Check the board is close to the remote, and that the remote's battery is fine.

pick.title: Choose the remote
pick.description: A light reacts to presses with group 0 and to its own group. Choose the group the light is paired to on this remote: 1 for most lights. A group 1 or group 2 press selects it for you.

data.group: Group the light is paired to

test.title: Test
test.description: Sending power twice to remote {remote}, group {group}, from {board}. The light should turn off and on again, or on and off again.

menu_options.name: It did: continue
menu_options.other_group: It didn't: try the other group

data.name: Name
data.proxy: ESPHome board that sends to the light

abort.no_boards: No ESPHome board able to send was found. The boards need the ble_adv_proxy component with the adv_svc_v2 service.
abort.already_configured: This remote and group is already set up.

progress.listen: Press a button on the other remote, close to an ESPHome board. Listening for {seconds} seconds.

data.proxy: ESPHome board that sends to the light

pick.title: Link a remote
pick.description: The light will follow presses from this remote too. Choose the group the light is paired to on it.

data.group: Group the light is paired to

remove.title: Remove linked remotes
remove.description: The first remote can't be removed: it's the one the light is sent as.

abort.already_linked: This remote and group is already linked to the light.
abort.nothing_to_remove: Only the first remote is linked, and it can't be removed.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a remote command to the light. A count above 1 is sent like a held button.

command.name: Command
command.description: power, night, max, brighter, dimmer, cooler, warmer, max2, group1, group2, or a command number.

count.name: Count
count.description: Number of presses, 0.21 s apart, like holding the button.
